query:
UPDATE harnesses
            SET
                name = COALESCE($2, name),
                allow_permission_bypass = COALESCE($3, allow_permission_bypass),
                owner_user_id = $4,
                team_id = $5,
                workspace_path = CASE WHEN $6 THEN $7 ELSE workspace_path END,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = $1
